prompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity 9:16 mobile website first-viewport comp for World Champion Taekwondo Washougal. This is a designed responsive WEBSITE screenshot, not a poster, not an ad, and not photoreal embroidery. Preserve the desktop reference's distinctive dobok-collar V architecture while adapting it for a phone.

At the very top, draw a thin ivory website header with a small circular school mark at left, the text “WCT Washougal” beside it, and a compact menu icon at right. Below it, build the hero as a clear mobile web composition.

CRITICAL COLLAR GEOMETRY: Draw the black dobok collar tape as PAGE ARCHITECTURE. Two broad, clean, matte-black drawn geometric tape bands originate flush at the LEFT and RIGHT EDGES of the viewport, visibly flowing off-canvas at both sides, then angle inward and meet in a strong open V. The bands should act like architectural diagonal planes dividing the page. They must NEVER form a closed picture frame around the photo. There must be NO black or gold tape across the top of the photo, NO vertical tape border hugging the left or right edge of the photo, NO chevron stamp, NO boxed image, and NO gold border rectangle. Keep only a restrained single line of gold stitch #C9A227 within each black diagonal tape band, just visible and clearly drawn/vector-like.

Place the real three students from the supplied home-hero-v4 photo together in the open clearing created by the V. Preserve these exact three students and their recognizable white doboks, poses, relative grouping, and Washougal dojang setting; do not invent, replace, duplicate, or remove any child. Art-direct the crop so ALL THREE students remain fully visible as a group, including bodies and feet, rather than cropping to the center girl. The photo itself has clean open edges and is not outlined, framed, taped, stamped, or bordered.

Use the areas created by the V as a strong editorial mobile website layout: an ivory field for copy and a navy #0D1B2A lower field or continuation, with sacred blue #0054B7 and red #E70E1B used decisively but sparingly. Headline exact text: “Washougal trains here.” Render it as large flat website typography in navy or ivory, crisp ink, no metallic effect, no gold 3D lettering, no embroidery texture. Support exact text: “Master Chulan Kim. A safe, positive school for families.” Make it plainly readable as website body copy. Primary CTA exact text: “Reserve your first class” drawn as a flat red #E70E1B rank-tape-shaped web button with sufficient padding and a touch-friendly size, no glossy effects. Secondary action exact text: “Meet Master Kim” as a restrained website text link or outlined control.

Mobile hierarchy: compact header, bold readable headline, concise support copy, prominent primary CTA, clear secondary action, and the three-student photo all legible in the first viewport. Keep spacing intentional and interface-like. Calm authority plus warmth. Ivory, navy #0D1B2A, blue #0054B7, red #E70E1B, matte black collar tape, and subtle gold stitch #C9A227 only. Drawn SVG/CSS-style geometry and flat interface typography. No poster composition, no ornamental badge overload, no 3D gold text, no photoreal embroidery, no top photo border, no side photo border, no enclosed photo frame.
